messages:
Ravi: quick flag — cost dashboard shows some tenants with negative per-token after cache credits + eviction refunds. saw it on nightly rollup.
Kim: same. looks like eviction-window amortization + late-arriving cache hits double-counts credits.
Eloise: repro gist on staging:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/v1/chat/respond","chain":["frontend","nlg"],"prefetch":true,"evict_window":300}'
```
Pat: UX impact: customers see "-0.02 USD/token" and message the success team. we need a clear surface that explains adjusted vs raw.
Ravi: proposal: dashboard shows three columns: raw_token_cost, amortized_prefetch_credit, net_cost. default to net but collapse negative nets with an explainer. also add a filter "exclude prefetch amortization".
Kim: data side: we currently only emit cache_credit as an opaque number. suggest we add optional fields: credit_source and lineage_id (strings) so we can tie credits to originating prefetch events. keep optional to avoid cardinality explosion.
Eloise: sampling plan: deterministic sample by tenant_id at 2% default, 100% for canaries/org-paid. store lineage only for sampled events.
Pat: console needs an API that returns both series (raw and net) and a tooltip flow. i'll mock a small explainer and a CTA to "show sample traces" which queries lineage for sampled tenants.
Ravi: ops change: exclude canary traffic from amortized pools (we treat canaries as cold path). also add an alert: if route 95p net_cost < 0 for > 15min, send to econ-pagers in dry-run mode first.
Kim: note on storage: lineage_id is a short hash not full chain. credit_source is enum ["prefetch","eviction_refund","manual_adj"]. that should keep cardinality bounded.
Eloise: i'll open PR to add credit_source+lineage_id+cache_credit_number to econ.events (all optional).
Pat: i'll wire the UI toggle and the "show sampled traces" CTA, plus copy for the explainer.
Ravi: action items: (1) Eloise PR for schema (2) Kim sampling rollout plan and storage estimate (3) Pat UI mock + API contract (4) Ravi RFC for canary exclusion + alert.
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.14.0 deployed to staging (hash: d4e5f6a)
Eloise: tests green locally, will add migration notes.
Kim: i'll draft sampling config and post numbers later today.
Pat: will post mock in #design in ~1h.
Ravi: thanks team. meeting in 20 if anyone wants to sync. :thumbsup:
